visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shots of hands using a sharp knife to dice celery and carrots into small, uniform pieces on a yellow cutting board. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Hands continue to peel and chop tomatoes, finely dice onions, and slice red chili and garlic. Small bowls with ingredients are visible in the background. (3) Raw beef rib strips are sliced into cubes and placed in a stainless steel bowl, where they are mixed with liquid and colorful powdered spices. (4) In a pink Dutch oven, beef fat is rendered until crispy. Onions are then added and sautéed with salt and pepper from grinders. (5) Minced garlic, sliced chili, diced celery, and carrots are added to the pot and stirred together with a black spatula. (6) The seasoned beef cubes and fresh chopped tomatoes are added to the pot and mixed thoroughly until the vegetables and meat are coated. (7) Canned tomato sauce and water are poured over the mixture. The pot is covered with a lid to simmer. (8) The lid is removed to reveal a bubbling, thick red stew. Starch water is added to further thicken the sauce. (9) The final dish is served by pouring the rich beef stew over a dome of white rice on a pink plate, garnished with green broccoli.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 西洋芹兩支切成細丁. (2) [Subtitle]: 紅蘿蔔一條先切成厚片. (3) [Subtitle]: 切成條狀再切成丁狀... (4) [Subtitle]: 2~3顆的牛番茄先去皮. (5) [Subtitle]: 去掉蒂. (6) [Subtitle]: 切成小塊狀. (7) [Subtitle]: 洋蔥一顆. (8) [Subtitle]: 辣椒一條斜切成片. (9) [Subtitle]: 蒜頭3~4瓣切成末. (10) [Subtitle]: 牛肋條 800克. (11) [Subtitle]: 去掉大塊肥油. (12) [Subtitle]: 切成塊狀... (13) [Subtitle]: 另不喜歡太油的人可將一半的份量替換成牛腱心. (14) [Subtitle]: 加入30ml of the 酒(紅酒亦可)鹽、黑胡椒、煙燻紅椒粉、辣椒粉、綜合香料、糖適量. (15) [Subtitle]: 充分抓揉均勻直到牛肉都被染紅為止. (16) [Subtitle]: 將切下來的牛脂肪放到鍋中煸出牛油用鍋鏟壓一下. (17) [Subtitle]: 取出. (18) [Subtitle]: 放入洋蔥丁. (19) [Subtitle]: 鹽、胡椒調味. (20) [Subtitle]: 繼續炒到洋蔥體積減少有些泛黃的樣子. (21) [Subtitle]: 放入蒜末、辣椒. (22) [Subtitle]: 繼續拌炒出香氣. (23) [Subtitle]: 接著放入西洋芹、紅蘿蔔丁繼續炒香. (24) [Subtitle]: 這時候可以放入兩大匙的番茄膏、10克的煙燻紅椒粉可以增加料理的顏色跟風味！ (25) [Subtitle]: 炒到蔬菜都被染紅為止. (26) [Subtitle]: 放入牛肋塊. (27) [Subtitle]: 繼續跟蔬菜拌炒. (28) [Subtitle]: 直到牛肋都被染紅為止. (29) [Subtitle]: 放入汆燙好的牛腱. (30) [Subtitle]: (全部都用牛肋的話，可省略). (31) [Subtitle]: 稍微拌炒均勻. (32) [Subtitle]: 放入新鮮番茄丁. (33) [Subtitle]: 將番茄炒軟. (34) [Subtitle]: 番茄軟化後會漸漸出水... (35) [Subtitle]: 這時候放入一罐義大利麵番茄醬罐頭. (36) [Subtitle]: 瓶子裡加入半罐的水. (37) [Subtitle]: 繼續的拌炒均勻. (38) [Subtitle]: 充分的拌勻. (39) [Subtitle]: 最後加入30ml的伍斯特醬增加酸味！ (40) [Subtitle]: 轉到最小火蓋上鍋蓋燉煮一小時左右！ (41) [Subtitle]: 等待的時候，可做別的事. (42) [Subtitle]: 好囉，開蓋~. (43) [Subtitle]: 哇！好香喔！❤️. (44) [Subtitle]: 咕嚕咕嚕的聲音肚子都餓. (45) [Subtitle]: 喜歡醬汁稠稠的最後可以放入一點太白粉勾芡~. (46) [Subtitle]: 減肥的人，省略即可. (47) [Subtitle]: 稠稠的. (48) [Subtitle]: 稠稠的醬汁~搭配飯一起吃超好吃！❤️. (49) [Subtitle]: 碗裡裝滿飯然後倒扣到盤子裡. (50) [Subtitle]: 把燉牛肉倒進來... (51) [Subtitle]: 放入一點花椰菜裝飾一下！ (52) [Subtitle]: 超級好吃❤️大人小孩都愛的燉牛肉，就完成啦~. (53) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理請追蹤我 IG 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房 YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Rapid, sharp percussive sounds of a knife hitting a wooden board dominate as vegetables are diced. A cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic guitar melody begins, providing a rhythmic backdrop. The narrator's voice is warm and clear, introducing the task with a professional yet friendly tone. (2) The acoustic texture shifts to softer, wetter slicing sounds as tomatoes are prepared. This is followed by the distinct metallic resonance of a stainless steel bowl being moved. The BGM maintains a steady pace, and the vocal energy remains moderate and consistent. (3) A series of metallic clicks and grinds occur as salt and pepper are added, followed by the wet, squelching sound of raw meat being mixed with seasonings in a bowl. The narration explains the ingredients with precise articulation, while the BGM provides a bright, domestic atmosphere. (4) A high-frequency sizzle erupts as fat is placed in a hot pan, transitioning into a steady bubbling sound as liquids are added. The narrator’s tone becomes slightly more excited, matching the visual progress. The sound of a spatula scraping the pot surface is audible. (5) A resonant metallic clink sounds as a heavy lid is placed over the pot, followed by a momentary dip in ambient noise. Later, a sharp 'clack' signifies the lid being lifted, followed by an enthusiastic exclamation from the narrator expressing delight at the aroma. (6) The sound of liquid being stirred and poured onto a plate concludes the sequence. The BGM swells slightly in volume during the final presentation. The narrator closes with a cheerful call to action, maintaining a high-arousal, positive emotional valence.
